reserveReview.rationale: Primary yield-generation, analytics and wrapper documentation re-read at 2026-10-09T10:31:59Z. The issuer still describes USDC -> StakeableAsset -> StrategyRouter -> VenusUSDVault -> Venus Protocol and allows future strategies, but supplies no dated complete position inventory or same-block sUSD/hUSDC liability-to-asset denominator. getProtocolStats() documentation distinguishes cumulative totalUSDCDeposited from contractUSDCBalance; neither establishes current gross vUSDC backing. The 100% row remains historical strategy context, with its August 20 composition date unchanged and selected-slices scope retained. Current allocation, BSC USDC representation custody and all-path reconciliation require independently pinned contract identity, gross vUSDC assets/exchange rate, idle balances, debt and outstanding liabilities. The fragment classifies only the missing current composition disclosure as researched non-disclosure; it grants no current reserve, custody or dependency credit.
